distance_definition: C-alpha to C-alpha distance to the nearest verified PTM residue
method: AlphaFold C-alpha model in UniProt numbering (chain A), residues with pLDDT >= 70. Distance = C-alpha to C-alpha distance to the nearest verified PTM residue. A residue qualifies if it is within 20.0 A of a verified PTM residue and >= 20 residues from every verified PTM residue in sequence. Missense mutations from the selected cBioPortal study are kept only if their reference residue matches the model, then collapsed to distinct positions. The null universe is the eligible residues only (confident, not PTM, >= min_sep from all PTMs). Exact hypergeometric tail plus an amino-acid-composition-matched permutation null (requested 0, seed 1) drawn from eligible residues. Neither null models trinucleotide context, clonality or mutational signatures; distance enrichment alone does not show functional effect.
